common_data_policy.required_timestamp_order: event_time <= available_time <= decision_time; ingested_time is lineage only
common_data_policy.prices: point-in-time total-return series for research returns; unadjusted OHLCV retained for event rules
common_data_policy.tradability: exchange calendar plus suspension and executable-price evidence required
common_data_policy.currency: portfolio returns converted with point-in-time FX into the frozen portfolio base currency
common_data_policy.source_gate: production data quality certification must be passed before analysis

event_study.event_definitions_and_targets: must be supplied by the frozen manifest before results are inspected

conditional_probability.dependence_policy: effective cooldown is at least the maximum horizon
conditional_probability.pairs_and_directions: must be supplied by the frozen manifest before results are inspected

market_graph.causality_policy: correlation and lead-lag edges are statistical associations, not causal claims
market_graph.node_selection: must be supplied by the frozen manifest before results are inspected

alpha_discovery.selection_policy: train selects, validation ranks, test remains untouched until final evaluation

portfolio_risk.return_method: daily time-weighted return with point-in-time FX
portfolio_risk.drawdown_method: peak-to-trough on the compounded equity curve
portfolio_risk.holdings_and_cash_flows: must be supplied by a frozen, effective-dated portfolio ledger

reporting_policy.confidence_semantics: evidence quality, not probability of future profit
